groups.conditions: Diabetes, kidney disease, established CVD and atrial fibrillation
groups.acute: Acute chest pain and coronary syndromes

models.name: SCORE2
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, ages 40-69, four ESC risk regions
models.verification: 1,532/1,536 cells of the ESC 2021 charts within printed precision; R RiskScorescvd; the paper's worked example.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2

score2(age=[50, 62], sex=["male", "female"], smoker=[1, 0], sbp=[140, 130],
       total_chol=[5.5, 6.1], hdl_chol=[1.3, 1.6], diabetes=0, region="low")

models.name: SCORE2-OP
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, ages 70-89, adjusted for competing risk
models.verification: 1,024/1,024 cells of the ESC 2021 charts within printed precision; R RiskScorescvd.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_op

score2_op(age=75, sex="female", smoker=0, sbp=150, total_chol=5.8,
          hdl_chol=1.5, diabetes=0, region="moderate")

models.name: SCORE2-Diabetes
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk in type 2 diabetes, ages 40-69
models.verification: Official U-Prevent calculator (21/22 displayed values); R RiskScorescvd; 7/8 printed worked examples (1 misprint).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_diabetes

score2_diabetes(age=60, sex="male", smoker=0, sbp=140, total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.2,
                diabetes=1, age_at_diabetes_diagnosis=52, hba1c=58, egfr=80, region="moderate")

models.name: SCORE2-CKD
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with eGFR (and optionally albuminuria) add-ons
models.verification: Developers' CKD-PC online calculator (71 patients x 4 regions); the supplement's worked example; R RiskScorescvd.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_ckd

score2_ckd(age=60, sex="male", smoker=0, sbp=140, total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.3,
           diabetes=0, egfr=45, region="moderate", acr=30, addon="acr")

models.name: SCORE2 Asia-Pacific
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, ages 40-69, four Asia-Pacific risk regions
models.verification: 1,535/1,536 cells of the developers' charts (1 print slip); R RiskScorescvd.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_asia_pacific

score2_asia_pacific(age=55, sex="male", smoker=1, sbp=140, total_chol=5.5,
                    hdl_chol=1.2, diabetes=0, region="high")

models.name: SCORE
models.outcome: 10-year fatal CVD, total-cholesterol model, high- and low-risk regions
models.verification: All 800 cells of the official charts (798 within printed precision; 2 chart anomalies documented).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score

score(age=60, sex="male", total_chol=6.0, sbp=150, smoker=1, region="high")

models.name: Globorisk
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk recalibrated to each country and calendar year
models.verification: Verified against the authors' R package 1.0.2.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import globorisk

globorisk(age=55, sex="male", sbp=140, smoker=1, country="MEX", year=2020,
          total_chol=5.5, diabetes=0)

models.name: WHO 2019
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, laboratory and non-laboratory versions
models.verification: Every cell of the 42 official WHO charts and R WHORiskCalculator.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import who2019

who2019(age=55, sex="female", sbp=145, smoker=0, total_chol=6.0, diabetes=1,
        country="EGY")

models.name: PREVENT
models.fullName: AHA Predicting Risk of CVD EVENTs
models.outcome: 10- and 30-year total CVD, ASCVD, heart failure, CHD and stroke; base, UACR, HbA1c, SDI and full models
models.verification: Official AHA online calculator (189/189 displayed risks, 34 patients); the authors' worked examples; R preventr.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import prevent

prevent(age=50, sex="female", sbp=160, bp_treated=1, total_chol=5.2, hdl_chol=1.4,
        statin=0, diabetes=1, smoker=0, egfr=90, bmi=35, years=10, outcome="total_cvd")

models.name: Pooled Cohort Equations
models.outcome: 10-year hard ASCVD, ages 40-79, white and African American
models.verification: ACC CVD Risk Estimator+ code run on 20,000 patients; the guideline's Table A (46/46); R CVrisk and PooledCohort.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import pce

pce(age=55, sex="female", race="white", total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.3, sbp=120,
    bp_treated=0, smoker=0, diabetes=0)

models.name: Framingham
models.outcome: 10-year general CVD, laboratory and BMI versions
models.verification: The Framingham Heart Study's own calculator spreadsheets, the paper's worked examples (32/32) and R CVrisk.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import framingham

framingham(age=61, sex="female", sbp=124, bp_treated=0, smoker=1, diabetes=0,
           total_chol=4.65, hdl_chol=1.22)

models.name: Reynolds
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with hsCRP and parental history
models.verification: Nancy Cook's own SAS code (senior author) run on 2,000 patients: exact for men; for women its baseline survival differs from the paper's (documented). 19/19 printed terms; 17/17 worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import reynolds

reynolds(age=60, sex="female", sbp=135, total_chol=5.7, hdl_chol=1.3, hscrp=3.0,
         smoker=0, parental_history=1)

models.name: QRISK3
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with ethnicity, deprivation and clinical conditions
models.verification: ClinRisk's own C code and R QRISK3 (LGPL-3.0 module).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import qrisk3

qrisk3(age=64, sex="female", ethnicity="indian", smoking="non", bmi=27, chol_hdl_ratio=4.0,
       sbp=140, sbp_sd=8, townsend=0)

models.name: QRISK2
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with ethnicity, deprivation and clinical conditions
models.verification: ClinRisk's own C code, including its 30,000-patient validation (2.9e-13) (LGPL-3.0 module).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import qrisk2

qrisk2(age=64, sex="female", ethnicity="indian", smoking="non", bmi=27, chol_hdl_ratio=4.0, sbp=140)

models.name: FINRISK
models.outcome: 10-year CHD, stroke and combined risk, ages 30-74
models.verification: Official Finnish calculator: 560 values, max relative difference 3e-16 (40 more floored by its display); Table 1 (4/4 equations).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import finrisk

finrisk(age=50, sex="male", smoker=1, total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.3, sbp=140,
        diabetes=0, parent_mi=1, parent_stroke=0, outcome="cvd")

models.name: ADRS
models.outcome: 10-year ASCVD, hard CAD and stroke, ages 18+
models.verification: Implemented from Table 2 and the supplement's SPSS syntax (32/32 terms agree); no worked example or calculator exists.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import adrs

adrs(age=50, sex="male", smoker=1, sbp=135, dbp=85, tc_hdl=4.5, diabetes=0,
     hypertension=1, bp_treated=1, vitamin_d=25, egfr=95, outcome="ascvd")

models.name: PROCAM
models.outcome: 10-year major coronary event category (men and women 20-75) and ischaemic stroke/TIA risk (35-65)
models.verification: Tables 2-4 and 6-7 checked against the PDF (50/50 point bands, 95/95 risk-table rows, 39/39 stroke risks); 1 printed overlap documented.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import procam

procam(age=50, sex="male", ldl_chol=4.4, hdl_chol=1.0, triglycerides=2.0, sbp=140,
       smoker=1, diabetes=0, family_history=0)

models.name: REGICOR
models.outcome: 10-year coronary events, ages 35-74
models.verification: Official REGICOR charts (men 198/200 cells within 0.01 points; women within 1 point); Wilson 1998 Table 6 verbatim; both worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import regicor

regicor(age=55, sex="male", total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.15, sbp=145, dbp=90,
        diabetes=0, smoker=1)

models.name: PREDICT
models.outcome: 5-year CVD (primary prevention, BMI, policy, type 2 diabetes), major bleeding, after CVD and after ACS
models.verification: The authors' R code run unmodified (21,000 patients, max difference 5e-13); 49/49 printed table rows and both worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import predict_cvd

predict_cvd(age=55, sex="female", ethnicity="maori", nzdep=4, smoking="ex", diabetes=0,
            af=0, family_history=1, sbp=140, tc_hdl=4.5, bp_meds=1, lipid_meds=0,
            antithrombotic=0)

models.name: SMART-REACH
models.outcome: 10-year recurrent CVD risk and CVD-free life expectancy in established CVD
models.verification: The authors' calculator spreadsheet (600 patients, 3e-15); a life-expectancy defect in it documented.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import smart_reach

smart_reach(age=65, sex="male", smoker=0, diabetes=1, sbp=135, total_chol=4.5,
            creatinine=90, cad=1, cerebrovascular=0, pad=0)

models.name: LIFE-CVD2
models.outcome: Lifetime risk to 80, CVD-free life expectancy and treatment benefit
models.verification: The authors' 16 published charts (7,167/7,168 cells within printed precision).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import life_cvd2

life_cvd2(age=50, sex="female", smoker=1, sbp=150, total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.4,
          region="moderate", outcome="lifetime_risk")

models.name: DIAL2
models.outcome: 10-year and lifetime CVD risk and CVD-free life expectancy in type 2 diabetes
models.verification: Official U-Prevent calculator (58/60 displayed values, 20 patients; 2 mis-copied) and the paper's two worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import dial2

dial2(age=60, sex="male", smoker=0, sbp=140, total_chol=5.0, hdl_chol=1.1, hba1c=58,
      egfr=80, age_at_diagnosis=55, region="moderate", outcome="lifetime_risk")

models.name: CHA2DS2-VASc
models.outcome: Stroke risk points in atrial fibrillation (0-9)
models.verification: Every input combination at every age cut point (640/640) against the paper's point table; R cliot and MedCalc-Bench (640/640 each).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import cha2ds2_vasc

cha2ds2_vasc(age=72, sex="female", heart_failure=0, hypertension=1, diabetes=0,
             stroke_tia_te=0, vascular_disease=0)

models.name: CHADS2
models.outcome: Stroke risk points in atrial fibrillation (0-6)
models.verification: Every input combination at every age cut point (160/160) against the paper's point table; R cliot (160/160).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import chads2

chads2(age=76, heart_failure=1, hypertension=1, diabetes=0, stroke_tia=0)

models.name: HAS-BLED
models.outcome: Major bleeding risk points on anticoagulation (0-9)
models.verification: Every input combination at every age cut point (2,560/2,560) against the paper's point table; R cliot and MedCalc-Bench (2,560/2,560 each).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import has_bled

has_bled(age=70, hypertension=1, abnormal_renal=0, abnormal_liver=0, stroke=0,
         bleeding=0, labile_inr=1, drugs=1, alcohol=0)

models.name: HEART
models.outcome: Major adverse cardiac events in chest pain (0-10)
models.verification: Published point rules (18/18); R RiskScorescvd (5,000 patients identical).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import heart

heart(history=1, ecg=1, age=58, risk_factors=2, atherosclerosis=0, troponin_ratio=0.5)

models.name: TIMI
models.outcome: 14-day adverse events in UA/NSTEMI (0-7)
models.verification: The TIMI Study Group's own calculator app (128/128 input combinations); published point rules (11/11); R RiskScorescvd (5,000 patients identical).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import timi

timi(age=68, risk_factors=3, coronary_stenosis=1, st_deviation=1, anginal_events_24h=2,
     aspirin_7d=1, elevated_markers=0)

models.name: EDACS
models.fullName: Emergency Department Assessment of Chest pain Score
models.outcome: Low-risk chest pain identification in the emergency department
models.verification: Published point rules (29/29); R RiskScorescvd (5,000 patients identical).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import edacs

edacs(age=52, sex="male", known_cad=0, risk_factors=2, diaphoresis=0,
      radiates_arm_shoulder=1, pleuritic=0, palpation=0)

models.name: GRACE
models.outcome: In-hospital (Granger 2003) and 6-month post-discharge (Eagle 2004) mortality points in ACS
models.verification: Published nomograms (78/78 bands at both ends); the 6-month score equals the developers' archived GRACE calculator on all 87,808 band combinations.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import grace_hospital

grace_hospital(killip=1, sbp=120, heart_rate=90, age=70, creatinine=1.2,
               cardiac_arrest=0, st_deviation=1, elevated_enzymes=1)

models.name: GRACE 2.0
models.outcome: 1- and 3-year death, and death or MI, after ACS admission; with substitutions for creatinine and Killip class
models.verification: The developers' calculator code run unmodified (24,572/24,572 displayed values); Fox 2014 Table 2 (24/24 hazard ratios).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import grace2

grace2(age=70, heart_rate=90, sbp=120, cardiac_arrest=0, st_deviation=1,
       elevated_enzymes=1, creatinine=1.2, killip=1, horizon=1, outcome="death")

models.name: SMART2
models.region: Europe and five other world regions
models.outcome: 10-year recurrent MI, stroke or vascular death, ages 40-80
models.verification: Official U-Prevent calculator (50/50 comparable patients); the supplement's SBP scale and a missing constant recovered from it.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import smart2

smart2(age=65, sex="male", smoker=0, diabetes=1, sbp=135, non_hdl_chol=3.5, egfr=75,
       hscrp=2.0, years_since_diagnosis=5, cad=1, cerebrovascular=0, pad=0, aaa=0,
       region="europe_moderate")

models.name: ASSIGN
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with social deprivation (SIMD) and family history, ages 30-74
models.verification: Version 2.0: official NHS Scotland calculator, 200/200 displayed scores; version 1.0: constants vs the 2007 appendix.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import assign

assign(age=55, sex="male", total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.2, sbp=140, diabetes=0,
       family_history=1, cigarettes_per_day=10, simd_score=20)

models.name: CUORE
models.outcome: 10-year first major CVD event, ages 35-69
models.verification: Official ISS online calculator (300/300 displayed values); Table 2 hazard ratios (13/14; 1 misprint).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import cuore

cuore(age=55, sex="male", sbp=140, tc=220, hdl=50, smoker=1, diabetes=0, bp_treatment=0)

models.name: China-PAR
models.fullName: Prediction for ASCVD Risk in China
models.outcome: 10-year first ASCVD event (MI, CHD death, stroke) with waist, region and urbanisation
models.verification: Official calculator (cvdrisk.com.cn): 550/550 displayed values with coefficients recovered within 0.005 of the paper's; the printed 2-decimal coefficients alone miss it by up to 12.7 points.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import china_par

china_par(age=60, sex="male", sbp=130, bp_treated=0, total_chol=5.4, hdl_chol=1.4,
          waist=80, smoker=0, diabetes=1, north=1, urban=1, family_history=0)

models.name: Suita
models.outcome: 10-year CHD points with CKD, total- or LDL-cholesterol sheet
models.verification: Point sheets checked against the paper's Cox coefficients; one baseline survival fits both probability tables; two web calculators of the JAS 2017 adaptation agree on every shared item.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import suita

suita(age=55, sex="male", smoker=1, diabetes=0, sbp=140, dbp=85, hdl=50, egfr=70, tc=220)

models.name: Suita CVD
models.outcome: 10-year stroke or CHD points, with and without ECG
models.verification: Every point equals 10 x the paper's coefficient (40/40); Table 4's probability bands as printed; R Jcvrisk gives the same band except at its SBP 139 / DBP 89 cut-point gap.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import suita_cvd

suita_cvd(age=55, sex="male", sbp=135, dbp=85, bp_treated=0, hdl=45, smoker=1,
          diabetes=0, proteinuria=0, ldl=150)

models.name: Hisayama
models.outcome: 10-year first ASCVD event (CHD or atherothrombotic infarction), ages 40-84; equation and point score
models.verification: The Japan Atherosclerosis Society's official 2022 app, run unmodified (3,920/3,920 patients; point score); points equal weight / 0.144 (18/18); R Jcvrisk (2,702/2,702); a web calculator of the JAS 2022 chart (79/80 cells).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import hisayama

hisayama(age=60, sex="male", sbp=140, diabetes=0, hdl=50, proteinuria=0, smoker=1,
         exercise=0, ldl=130)

models.name: EPOCH-JAPAN
models.outcome: 10-year death from CHD, stroke or CVD, ages 40-79
models.verification: Both worked examples reproduced; stroke and CVD equal to R Jcvrisk (2,416/2,416); its CHD function enters ln TC for ln TC/HDL (documented).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import epoch_japan

epoch_japan(age=60, sex="male", sbp=140, smoker=1, diabetes=0, proteinuria=0,
            total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.3, outcome="chd")

models.name: JALS
models.outcome: 5- and 10-year stroke, AMI, stroke + AMI and CVD death, with and without AF; points (risk via jals_risk)
models.verification: Points equal 10 x log2 of the printed rate ratios (174/176, 2 at a rounding edge); risk table recovered from Table 6 (257/260 five-year values, the rest within 0.01); R Jcvrisk equals the supplement's ACC/AHA variant on 3,000 patients.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import jals

jals(age=75, sex="male", sbp=165, dbp=85, bp_treated=0, smoker=0, diabetes=0,
     outcome="stroke", af=0)

models.name: WHO/ISH
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD risk band, with and without cholesterol
models.verification: Every cell of the guideline's two printed charts (768/768) and R whoishRisk (3 transcription errors in it corrected).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import who_ish

who_ish(age=60, sex="male", smoker=1, sbp=150, diabetes=0, region="eur_a", total_chol=6.0)
